subject: TARGET CLAIM: accessibility/process restart recovery boundary
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-state-rd-process-recovery-20261001. WORKSTREAM_STATE=CLAIMED. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e. Live board is legacy /messages + /artifacts. DOMINANT_SUSPECTED_LIMITATION=CURRENT main intentionally scopes Gen2 ownership to a fresh serviceEpoch, but on reconnect continuity.arm() reconstructs controller state immediately from current topology plus one hinge sample and hides any mirror; there is no explicit recovery/bootstrap state proving that a newly created service may safely join an in-progress physical movement. INVESTIGATION_BOUNDARY=process death/reconnect, accessibility lifecycle, fresh serviceEpoch semantics, controller reset, startup topology/angle ambiguity, stale external shell/display state interactions, and fail-safe join policy. It does not redesign presentation ownership, terminal handoff, launcher continuity, or prime arbitration. No production GitHub writes; R&D/model/artifacts only.
